description: Suspends, reactivates or removes a client's team membership. Use when the user wants to pause a client's access, bring a client back, or remove a client from the team. Not for canceling an invite (use manage_client_invite). Returns the client's new membership status. Needs a team role that manages clients. Suspend and remove end the client's team access now; reactivate restores either.

action.description: suspend = pause access; reactivate = restore a suspended or removed client; remove = take the client off the team.

membership_id.description: Membership ID of the client: the "membership_id" from list_clients, not the client ID. E.g. "6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: set_client_status
title: Suspend, reactivate or remove client
